lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct high-contrast white vertical segments. Spacing is relatively uniform across the central torso, with a slight increase in inter-line distance towards the shoulder and haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One visible Y-shaped bifurcation occurs on the 6th vertical line from the posterior, splitting at the upper dorsal margin.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most vertical line is abbreviated, terminating mid-way down the torso mass. A single isolated white spot is located between the 3rd and 4th lines at mid-flank height.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A group of 5 distinct white spots is visible on the lower lateral haunch, below the primary vertical stripe termination points.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lateral upper hind limb align horizontally, creating a short semi-connected geometric segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white patch on the lower ventral neck/throat; distinct white facial spots on the muzzle; high-contrast black 'socks' on the distal portion of all four limbs.
